source: docs/02 §2 (K1-K8), docs/01 D24-D25 (sensitivity is not egress)

category.label: Category
category.instructions: Which type of knowledge is this document?

K1.name: Reference work
K1.desc: Long text that people read to find facts: manual, standard, vendor document, law.
K1.use: Select when the text describes a product, a rule or a standard.
K1.not: Not K2: it does not give the steps for one task. Not K4: it is prose, not a table or a schema.
K1.example: A vendor manual. A law. A product overview README.

K2.name: Procedure / runbook
K2.desc: The steps to do one task: install, operate, repair, standard operating procedure.
K2.use: Select when a person does the steps in sequence.
K2.not: Not K3: the reader is a person, not an AI agent. Not K5: it tells what to do, not what occurred.
K2.example: Restore the database from a backup.

K3.name: Agent instruction
K3.desc: Text that controls how an AI agent operates: skill, prompt, agent card, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md.
K3.use: Select when an AI agent reads the text as its instructions.
K3.not: Not K2: the reader is an agent. A runbook that an agent also uses stays K2 if a person can do the steps.
K3.example: CLAUDE.md. A skill file. A system prompt.

K4.name: Structured reference
K4.desc: Data with a fixed structure: API schema, list of values, catalog, glossary, configuration reference.
K4.use: Select when people or tools look up one item in it.
K4.not: Not K1: it is a table, a list or a schema, not prose.
K4.example: An OpenAPI schema. A list of error codes. A glossary.

K5.name: Record / evidence
K5.desc: Text that records what occurred: report, review, decision record, handover note, test or audit evidence, transcript.
K5.use: Select when the text records events, results or decisions at a specified time.
K5.not: Not K6: it records one case; it does not give a general lesson.
K5.example: A code review. A test report. A decision record. A handover note.

K6.name: Learned knowledge
K6.desc: Lessons, patterns, FAQ, or a summary made from other documents.
K6.use: Select when the text gives general rules or lessons from experience.
K6.not: Not K5: it is not the record of one event. Not K1: it comes from experience, not from a standard.
K6.example: Lessons learned. A list of known problems and their causes. An FAQ.

K7.name: Model / decision artefact
K7.desc: A model, an evaluation report of a model, or the definition of a decision model.
K7.use: Select when the text defines, trains or measures a model.
K7.not: Not K5: a general test report is K5; a model evaluation is K7.
K7.example: A model card. A model evaluation. A decision table that a model uses.

K8.name: Secret material
K8.desc: Text that contains or points to a key, password, certificate or token.
K8.use: Select when the text contains a secret or tells where to find one.
K8.not: The secret scan removes most of these documents. If you see one, select K8 and write a note.
K8.example: A file with an API key. A note that gives a password.

NONE.name: Does not fit
NONE.desc: No category is correct (for example: plan, design, brainstorm).
NONE.use: Select when no category above is correct.
NONE.not: Write a note with a better name. These notes help to improve the categories.
NONE.example: A design proposal. A project plan. Brainstorm notes.

normal.name: Normal
normal.desc: All authorized persons in the organization can read it.
normal.use: Select when the text has no item from the restricted list.
normal.example: A general how-to. A product description.

restricted.name: Restricted
restricted.desc: Only a small group can read it.
restricted.use: Select when the text has infrastructure details (host names, IP addresses, network layout), personal data, a security vulnerability or a trade secret.
restricted.not: A restricted document must stay local: the system does not accept restricted with cloud.
restricted.example: A security review. A server inventory.

egress.label: Egress
egress.instructions: Can a cloud model process this document?

local_only.name: Local only
local_only.desc: Only local models can process it.
local_only.use: Select when the text is restricted, or when you are not sure.
local_only.not: Egress is not sensitivity: a normal document can also be local only.

cloud_ok.name: Cloud OK
cloud_ok.desc: You can send it to a cloud model.
cloud_ok.use: Select when the text has no risk if a cloud provider sees it.

relevance.label: Does the passage answer the question?

help.yes: The passage gives the full answer.
help.partial: The passage gives part of the answer, or the answer needs other text too.
help.no: The passage does not answer the question.
help.bad_question: The question is not clear, not useful, or a person would not ask it.
